ticker_news.title: Why Marvell Stock Popped Today
ticker_news.description: Marvell Technology's stock rose 7.6% after Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $80, driven by potential AI chip production for Microsoft and promising revenue growth projections.
ticker_news.author: Rich Smith

ticker_news.title: Microsoft Earnings Preview: Short-Term Costs Could Fuel Long-Term AI Domination
ticker_news.description: Microsoft is positioned for long-term AI dominance despite short-term investment challenges, with Azure cloud platform growth and strategic AI partnerships driving potential $45 billion in AI-driven revenue by 2026.
ticker_news.author: Ali Merchant

ticker_news.title: Meta Earnings Preview: Can Social Media Giant Justify Massive Bet on AI?
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms is preparing to report quarterly earnings, with significant focus on its AI investments and potential increased spending to compete with tech rivals. The company's stock is currently in a corrective phase, and investors are watching closely to see how its AI strategy and ad revenues perform.
ticker_news.author: Damian Nowiszewski

SPY.title: S&P 500 Rally Stalls as Bearish Divergences Suggest a Pause Ahead
SPY.description: The S&P 500 rally is showing signs of potential stagnation due to bearish divergences, with technical indicators suggesting a possible modest pullback in the market, particularly in the 6100 range.
SPY.author: Tim Ord
